thread:
sam-sales: Heads up — POC with Acme (trial) is stuck. They can't correlate app traces with logs in our Console. Their trace IDs show up in app but our log export to Datadog drops trace headers and we're seeing 429s on export. Anyone free to help debug?

devon-eng: on it. Which export are they using? syslog? datadog agent?

sam-sales: They're using our log-drain -> Datadog HTTP endpoint via forwarder. Config attached from customer: `headers: [ Authorization, X-Trace-Id ]` They say `X-Trace-Id` appears in app logs but not in Datadog.

ingrid-sre: Datadog needs header `x-datadog-trace-id` (lowercase) and `x-datadog-parent-id` for span linking. Our export currently normalizes headers; might be dropping unknown headers during proxying. Can you paste the drain config?

sam-sales: paste: ```yaml
name: dd-forwarder
endpoint: https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/v1/input
headers:
  - 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
  - 'X-Trace-Id: ${trace_id}'
```

devon-eng: Ah — the forwarder sanitizer strips `X-Trace-Id` unless allowed in allowlist. There's a per-customer header allowlist on Dedicated/Private but default Hosted strips unknown headers for GDPR. Will check policy.

maria-devex: We should be able to map `X-Trace-Id` -> `x-datadog-trace-id` in the forwarder during export. Quick fix: create a transform rule. Is Acme on Hosted or Dedicated?

sam-sales: Hosted POC (trial). They asked for minimal changes — prefer we fix on our side.

ingrid-sre: Also seeing 429s — that suggests rate limiting on the forwarder or Datadog ingest. Do we have recent metric spikes? @logging-bot can you post last hour forwarder errors?

logging-bot: forwarder/errors rate: 429 spikes at 2027-08-11T15:02:03Z -> 15:10:47Z, 1200 reqs/min peak. Top error: 429 Rate limit exceeded (datadog).

devon-eng: Those 429s will drop headers randomly if we backoff/queue. We should enable buffering and retry headers preserved. Plan: (1) add transform mapping header name -> datadog expected header, (2) enable short buffering and exponential retry to smooth bursts, (3) request DD increase for POC or configure API key scoped throughput.

alex-product: :thinking_face: For Hosted, changing default allowlist is a product decision. Can we patch forwarder with per-team override for POC requests? Also need security sign-off for header mapping — might leak PII if header contains user id.

maria-devex: If trace id is just span id (no PII) security should be fine. @ingrid-sre can you confirm trace header payload format from the customer?

ingrid-sre: Acme says trace id is hex 16-32 chars. No user info. I'm fine to allow mapping for this customer with audit log. We'll record change and TTL it.

sam-sales: Customer asked for ETA — can we get a temporary workaround? They can also inject `x-datadog-trace-id` at the app level, but that's heavier.

devon-eng: Temporary quickfix: we can create a transform in their log route to copy `X-Trace-Id` -> `x-datadog-trace-id` before outbound. I can push a per-route transform in 30–60m and enable buffering. Will run through canary.

logging-bot: deploy/batch-transform 2070012380: canary started on forwarder-swarm-3

devon-eng: Canary shows headers are preserved now and Datadog trace linking works for a subset. 429s still at lower volume. I'm going to throttle client-side batch size and enable retries, this should reduce 429s.

sam-sales: I'll tell Acme we'll have a patch in canary and full roll within 2 hours. Also they asked about billing for extra throughput — what's policy?

alex-product: For POCs we usually absorb small ingest bursts; if sustained >1M events/day we discuss extra credits. For now absorb and monitor.

maria-devex: Action items: devon to roll transforms + buffer, ingrid to add audit note + security signoff, sam to update customer, alex to monitor billing exposure. Mark progress here.

ingrid-sre: Security signoff: approved for `acme-corp-poc` with audit key `audit-2070012345`. Retention: 24h change log. I'll post ticket.

devon-eng: rolling full patch now.

logging-bot: deploy/batch-transform 2070012435: full rollout complete on forwarder-swarm (nodes: 5), errors down 80%

sam-sales: Thanks team — Acme confirmed traces now show in Datadog and console correlation works. Closing POC blocker. :tada:
